skinCenter.advancedHint: Backdrop occlusion, blur and the custom theme are listed directly below.
skinCenter.appliedNeedRestart: Applied and confirmed, but the host did not hot-reload — restart dsh to take effect
skinCenter.appliedUnconfirmed: Applied, but the change has not been confirmed — refresh the page in dev mode; packaged installs (DSH Desktop) need an app restart
skinCenter.backgroundBlurHint: Applies a separate Gaussian blur to the backdrop for the empty conversation and the conversation with content; 0 disables.
skinCenter.backgroundBlurInert: Visible only with skins that paint a backdrop; the official default has none.
skinCenter.backgroundHint: Instantly veils the backdrop behind the panels — higher values obscure the art to help you focus.
skinCenter.backgroundHintInert: Only applies to skins that paint a backdrop (Blue Fantasy / Whale Song). Applies to the official default automatically once such a skin is active.
skinCenter.bubbleOpacityHint: Controls translucent message bubbles for skins that expose bubble alpha, such as Whale Mom.
skinCenter.cardDescription: Switch the stock look and the whale-song skin, and toggle the light/dark theme.
skinCenter.customThemeResetHint: Only resets the selected light or dark profile.
skinCenter.customThemeSaveFailed: Could not save custom theme changes.
skinCenter.customThemeTagline: A separately saved palette derived from the official default theme.
skinCenter.enabledHint: When off, try-on, apply and background controls are disabled; turn it back on to resume.
skinCenter.inputCardBlurHint: Blurs only the area behind the input card while backdrop art is visible; it does not blur the entire wallpaper.
skinCenter.intro: Try on any skin live — it takes effect instantly, exit restores the current look. Apply persists it across restarts.
skinCenter.offNote: The skin center is turned off.
skinCenter.officialTagline: The stock DSH look with no skin applied.
skinCenter.title: Skin Center
skinCenter.wallpaperDirBrowseFailed: Could not open the system folder picker — type the path manually instead
skinCenter.wallpaperDirBrowseHint: Pick a folder with the system file manager (Finder / Explorer)
skinCenter.wallpaperDirsHint: No Wallpaper Engine (e.g. macOS)? Point a folder at any .mp4/.webm files, a wallpaper project folder, or a folder of projects — they become your wallpaper library.
skinCenter.wallpaperEmpty: No wallpapers found. Subscribe in the Wallpaper Engine workshop, or add manual folders to the skin-wallpaper settings.
skinCenter.wallpaperHint: Use your local Wallpaper Engine library as the GUI backdrop: video, web, and scene wallpapers render live (scene wallpapers need WebGL).
skinCenter.wallpaperImportHint: Copy this wallpaper into local storage, so it keeps working even if the Steam library moves or changes
skinCenter.wallpaperLegal: Wallpapers belong to their Workshop authors. Everything stays on this machine for personal use; nothing is uploaded or shared.
skinCenter.wallpaperLibraryManual: Manual folders only (no Wallpaper Engine install found; set folders in the skin-wallpaper settings)
skinCenter.wallpaperLibrarySystem: macOS wallpapers detected (aerials and Desktop Pictures)
skinCenter.wallpaperSoundHint: Play video wallpaper audio. The browser may keep it silent until you click or press a key once.
skinCenter.wallpaperUpdateAvailable: The workshop original changed since import — update the local copy
